correctness.rationale: For every permitted symmetry center, reflection forces two base translates and a slab of constant sectional volume A; reflected apex points force the disjoint exterior pyramidal caps in each of the three t regimes. Their total volume supplies the universal bound, attained by the centered reflection hull because a lies in B. For d>=3 the height profile has a unique minimum at zero; any nonzero horizontal center strictly expands the base section, giving a strictly larger volume. Limits and endpoint parameters are handled analytically.
